title: Enabling Hybrid HPCQC Workflows with a Heterogeneous Software Stack
abstract: arXiv:2608.14827v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this work, we demonstrate hybrid High Performance Computing-Quantum Computing (HPCQC) workflows on a production petascale system. The demonstration combines three components: the SuperMUC-NG supercomputer at the Leibniz Supercomputing Centre (LRZ), a 20-qubit superconducting quantum processor provided by IQM Quantum Computers (IQM), and Munich Quantum Valley (MQV)'s Munich Quantum Software Stack (MQSS).   Integrating quantum processors into High Performance Computing (HPC) systems requires a heterogeneous software stack capable of orchestrating classical and quantum resources within established supercomputing workflows. MQSS treats Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) as scheduler-managed accelerators and it performs resource coordination following a two-level scheduling scheme. translated_title: 通过异构软件栈实现混合高性能计算与量子计算工作流
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14827v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在这项工作中，我们在生产级千万亿次系统上演示了混合高性能计算-量子计算（HPCQC）工作流。该演示结合了三个组件：莱布尼茨超级计算中心（LRZ）的SuperMUC-NG超级计算机、IQM量子计算机公司提供的20量子比特超导量子处理器，以及慕尼黑量子谷（MQV）的慕尼黑量子软件栈（MQSS）。将量子处理器集成到高性能计算（HPC）系统中，需要一种异构软件栈，能够在既定的超级计算工作流中编排经典和量子资源。MQSS将量子处理单元（QPU）视为由调度器管理的加速器，并采用两级调度方案进行资源协调。Slurm通过将QPU暴露为通用资源（GRES）来执行系统级分配，而MQSS量子资源管理器与编译器基础设施（QRM&CI）则负责后续的协调工作。
tldr: 本文展示了在真实千万亿次超级计算机上，通过异构软件栈MQSS将量子处理器作为调度器管理的加速器，实现混合HPCQC工作流的首次生产级演示。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates the first production-scale hybrid HPCQC workflow on a petascale system, using the heterogeneous MQSS software stack to integrate quantum processors as scheduler-managed accelerators.
